column1: # Real autocorrect cases reported on #500, replayed by main.swift: the field holds
# `before` then `typed`, the space bar commits `typed`, and `expected` is what the
# person meant. `reported` is what Dictus wrote when the case was filed; `filed` is
# the date of the comment. Characters are as reported, lowercase included.
# `lexicon` is what the contacts and text-replacements lexicon (#873) holds for the
# case, comma-separated, `shortcut=phrase` or a word; empty on the simulator. A device
# holds hundreds of entries, which is how "il ma" survived PR #970 there.
